newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent products basis tracks NYMEX higher.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent products basis tracks NYMEX higher.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel prices firmed late Thursday, tracking gains in NYMEX front-month futures prices, traders said.
Buyers emerged in the Group Three market following a sell-off that pushed diesel basis lower late Wednesday, and active trading was reported in Chicago unleaded barrels.
"There were more sellers than buyers yesterday," one trader said early in the day of the drop in Group Three diesel differentials. "But I'm talking to some buyers right now."
December front-month unleaded firmed more than 1.75 cents a gallon and heating oil made a similar upward move on the Merc.
Chicago unleaded was talked 4.50/4.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded for all November timings, with premium heard done 1.75 cents higher, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was bid 1.0 cent a gallon over NYMEX December heating oil for late-November deliveries, and high sulphur was bid even with the print.
Group Three unleaded was unchanged at 3.25/3.50 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and one cent a gallon weaker for later deliveries.

Group Three low sulphur diesel differentials remained 0.75/0.50 cent a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 1.0/0.75 cent under for later deliveries. High sulphur was talked steady at 1.50 cent a gallon under the print.
Jet/kero was bid 1.75 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 1.0 cent over in Group Three.
